root.label: Iran calls on Iraq to lift flight restrictions

events.label: Iran calls on Iraq to lift flight restrictions

slots.name: flight suspension status
slots.sentence: Iraq’s ambassador to Iran, Yasser Abdulzahra al-Hajjaj, said Baghdad had not decided to suspend Iranian flights.

slots.name: land journey duration
slots.sentence: Flights remained suspended at Baghdad, Erbil and Sulaimaniyah airports, forcing passengers onto land journeys of at least 12 hours and disrupting pilgrim traffic between the Shia-majority areas.

slots.name: statement date
slots.sentence: In a statement on Thursday, Iran’s Foreign Ministry condemned Washington’s “illegal and inhumane” efforts to disrupt Iran’s trade and air transport through the “extraterritorial enforcement” of US sanctions, and urged Baghdad to remove the restrictions.
